title: Cross-material cross-regime paired performance characterization
question: Does the F-AHL15 representation retain a complete-Richards CPU benefit across the same four materials and wet-mid-dry regimes for which fidelity has already closed 12/12?

timing_policy.compiler: gfortran -O3 without runtime checks or floating-point traps

broad_claim_rule: A broad Richards speed claim requires all 12 cases to retain the frozen fidelity gates and have median paired ratio < 0.98.
